The position’s major responsibilities include conducting research and providing support on issues related to Chinese corporations and Chinese foreign policy. Other major topics are US-China competition, Chinese macroeconomics, Indo-Pacific security and economic relations, and US strategy in the Indo-Pacific. Administrative duties include scheduling and organizing events. Other duties include overseeing long-term projects and mentoring department interns.

This position requires excellent writing, communication, research, and organizational skills, particularly a strong ability to read and research in Mandarin Chinese
. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated interest in Asian studies and should be academically curious and able to manage multiple competing priorities at once.

Qualified applicants should submit an online application complete with a resume, a cover letter, transcripts, and a 500-word writing sample on a topic related to the position.

Responsibilities

Research, edit, and assist in publishing policy reports about economics, international trade, authoritarian governance, security, and politics in the Indo-Pacific.
Help update the China Global Investment Tracker, including through data collection, in-depth research in Chinese, fact-checking, editing, and data visualization.
Help plan, organize, and coordinate major public and private conferences and private meetings by inviting speakers, drafting public invitation texts, and coordinating all logistics with AEI’s conferences and media affairs teams.
Coordinate program activities and administrative details by managing schedules; setting up meetings with various groups in Washington, DC, and with foreign contacts; and planning and executing all travel logistics.
Manage long-term projects by drafting proposals, mapping timelines, meeting project deadlines, coordinating with outside members of the project teams, organizing small working groups, editing longer publications, reporting on project progress to the Development department, and executing large conferences at the projects’ culmination.
Comply with the Foreign and Defense Policy department’s reporting guidelines and participate in and assist with department events and meetings.
Mentor Asia economics and security interns.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions at AEI

The employee is expected to regularly stand, sit, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, telephone, and keyboard. This job requires close-up vision for computer work.
The employee must be able to lift up to 30 pounds.
The employee must be able to work in a confined area.
Moderate noise (e.g., from computers, phones, printers, and light traffic) is expected.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities associated with this position.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in East Asian studies, international relations, political science, history, public policy, or a related field is required.
0–2 years of previous applicable full-time work experience is preferred; previous internship experience is strongly preferred.
Working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required.

Previous economics coursework is preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required.
Excellent research, writing, editing, organizational, and interpersonal skills are required.
A background in the Chinese economy, political economy, politics, or security is preferred.

Benefits

AEI offers generous benefits, including 18 days of paid leave (15 days of paid annual leave and 3 personal/floating holidays); 12 days of paid sick leave; paid family leave; medical and dental coverage, in addition to a health savings account; medical and dependent care FSA; a tuition assistance program of up to $5,200; life and disability insurance at no cost to employees; and a 403b retirement plan with a contribution from AEI, among other benefits. Repair Quality is an enterprise-wide program that establishes consistent repair standards, reduces repeat repairs, protects vehicle uptime, strengthens dealer accountability, and improves the customer service experience.

The Repair Quality Program Manager
will own and advance the program across the dealer service network. This role serves as the central lead for program strategy, standards, dealer audits, remediation decisions, reporting, communications, and continuous improvement. The Program Manager will collaborate with dealer, field, engineering, warranty, training, quality, digital, IT, supplier, and international-market stakeholders to ensure the program remains practical, measurable, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines strong program ownership, technical judgment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to translate complex service and quality requirements into an effective operating program.

Responsibilities

Own the Repair Quality vision, strategy, roadmap, requirements, and delivery plan, aligning priorities with vehicle uptime, dealer capability, customer experience, warranty performance, and enterprise quality objectives.
Serve as the program’s central point of contact and subject-matter lead, providing consistent interpretation of requirements and coordinating decisions across participating organizations.
Define and maintain Repair Quality standards, checkpoints, audit criteria, procedures, dealer guidance, evidence requirements, and supporting documentation.
Review dealer audits and remediation evidence, determine program status, and provide clear, consistent feedback regarding approval, remediation, or suspension-related outcomes.
Partner with Dealer Operations, field teams, and dealer leadership to support corrective actions, dealer recovery, and sustained compliance.
Maintain program dashboards, audit and remediation records, dealer status reporting, stakeholder communications, and a centralized repository of program materials.
Analyze audit findings, warranty trends, repeat repairs, field observations, customer concerns, and dealer feedback to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Lead the refinement and expansion of Repair Quality requirements through research, pilots, stakeholder review, training, communications, and management approval.
Collaborate with engineering, technical publications, training, warranty, quality, suppliers, digital, and IT teams to align repair methods, tools, systems, integrations, and workflows.
Establish and monitor success measures, including audit completion, approval status, remediation progress, dealer adoption, checkpoint performance, and repeat-repair trends.
Support implementation in additional products and approved markets through dealer visits, pilot evaluations, verification activities, workshops, and auditor training.
Drive cross-functional issues to resolution by clarifying ownership, managing trade-offs, escalating risks, and maintaining alignment on deliverables and measurable outcomes.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of technical project/program management experience

OR

Master's degree and at least 1 year of technical project/program management experience

OR

At least 5 years of technical project/program management experience

Experience managing cross-functional programs, products, or operational initiatives within service engineering, dealer operations, warranty, quality, or a related field.

Experience defining standards, audit criteria, compliance requirements, remediation workflows, or corrective-action programs.

Strong program and product-management skills, including developing strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.

Description

Research Assistant

Our clinical research company is looking to hire a qualified candidate for the full-time position of Research Assistant. The ideal candidate will possess a phlebotomy certification and have a desire to work directly with patients.

Who We Are

ObjectiveHealth is a clinical research company that uses proprietary technology to:

Increase patient access to research trials within our community
Provide physicians with enhanced care options for current patients, and
Deliver superior clinical research enrollment metrics to Pharma sponsors

All with the goal of Improving Patient Outcomes at the point of care.

We want you to join us in doing just that.

Who You Are

A lover of patient interaction and skilled at taking patient vitals
A team player with a bias for action and an attitude that takes personal responsibility
Skilled at performing and assisting with direct patient care activities: physical assessments, blood draws, medication administration, ECG, etc. (On the job training may be offered for those procedures not previously performed.)
Possess an acute attention to detail for clean data entry, regulatory compliance, productive site visits, efficient study set-up and maintenance, lab cleanliness, and strict protocol adherence
A good communicator with the goal of fostering relationships between the research team, PIs, Sponsors, Monitors, and others
A strong advocate for Company values, mission, and initiatives
Not easily distracted: You have the ability to stay focused while running different protocols, tracking patient reports, and maintaining eSource material for assigned studies
Energized by the idea of playing a role in the future of new therapy development in the areas of Gastroenterology, Urology, Dermatology, and/or Oncology

What Success Looks Like For This Role

Taking ownership of their assigned studies and patients
Communicating promptly and effectively with leadership and coworkers when you have a question or see something that needs correction
Ensuring strict compliance to the laws, regulations, and requirements of all applicable governing bodies
Learning and using the technologies we provide to increase efficiency in your day-to-day activities
Embodying our core values of Compassion, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, Velocity, and Dedication

What We Offer

Competitive compensation, 401(k) with Company match, a clear career pathway for advancement within the Company, Short- and Long-Term Disability, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Health, Dental and Vision insurance Plans, Generous PTO, Adoption Assistance, Paid Holidays, and a wide selection of other voluntary benefits.

Requirements

This job requires legal authorization to work in the US. We are not currently accepting work visas.
